# laravel_cloud_application (Resource)

Manages a Laravel Cloud application.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Application name (3-40 characters).
- `region` (String) Cloud region (e.g. us-east-1).
- `repository` (String) Source code repository (e.g. laravel/laravel).

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) Dedicated cluster ID.
- `slack_channel` (String) Slack channel for application notifications.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly slug.
- `source_control_provider_type` (String) Source control provider type (github, gitlab, or bitbucket). Becomes required by the API on March 9, 2026.

### Read-Only

- `avatar_url` (String) Application avatar URL.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Application ID.
